red_flags: Only 2 Google reviews exist for this specific school (Cees de Vaan / ceesdevaan.nl); no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, or other platform reviews found.

Of the 2 reviews, only 1 has any text, and that text is NOT a genuine customer/student review: it is a sarcastic 5-star 'review' from a road user apologizing for a traffic incident with the instructor, with ironic intent. It says nothing about lessons, teaching quality or being a pupil.
The other review (John Van Limpt) has no body text at all ('Geen beschrijving') — just a 5-star rating.
Easy to confuse with the much larger, unrelated 'Kees de Vaan Opleidingen BV' (keesdevaan.nl, 1416 klantenvertellen reviews) — those reviews are NOT for this school and were excluded.
Zero readable, substantive student reviews; 5.0/5 average is based on only 2 ratings and is not meaningful.
review_summary: There is essentially no genuine student-review content for this one-person school: only 2 Google reviews exist, one with no text and one that is a tongue-in-cheek 5-star 'review' from a road user about a traffic encounter (not a lesson). No verified or substantive customer reviews could be found, so review quality and student experience cannot be judged from the text.
